notes: Eleven distinct movable-part episodes are visible. The paired upper-cabinet leaves are reported separately because each is a distinct movable part, although their individual motions occur partly between sampled frames and their exact ordering is uncertain.
scene_description: A first-person traversal of a kitchen and adjacent living area. The user opens and later closes a refrigerator, dishwasher, oven, pantry and upper cabinets, then manipulates lids on two countertop cookers and the basket drawer of an air fryer.
